comment: One entry per scored signal. Severity is the ceiling: a signal scoring between full_severity_below and no_finding_above is demoted one step down the ladder. Remediation copy is data, so correcting the advice never touches the scorer.

citability.self_containment.title: Passages depend on the paragraph above them
citability.self_containment.remediation: Rewrite the opening sentence of each passage so it names its own subject. An engine lifts one paragraph, not the page: a paragraph that starts with "This also means..." arrives at the reader with nothing to point at.

citability.answer_first.title: Sections build up to the answer instead of leading with it
citability.answer_first.remediation: Put the direct answer in the first sentence under each heading, then explain. Move throat-clearing openers below the answer or delete them.

citability.structure.title: Heading structure does not segment the page into answerable sections
citability.structure.remediation: Give the page one H1 and at least three H2s, each phrased as the question its section answers. Do not skip heading levels; split any section over 400 words.

citability.evidence_density.title: Claims arrive without numbers, dates or sources
citability.evidence_density.remediation: Add the specific figure, date, version or measurement to each claim, and link the primary source. Passages carrying a checkable fact are the ones engines quote.

citability.extractability.title: Little usable content is present in the HTML the crawler receives
citability.extractability.remediation: Server-render the main content, or pre-render it for crawlers. Most AI crawlers do not execute JavaScript, so content that only appears after hydration does not exist to them.

citability.attribution.title: The page does not say who wrote it or when
citability.attribution.remediation: Add a visible byline, a published date and a last-modified date, and mirror them in Article or Organization JSON-LD. Attribution is what lets an engine decide the page is safe to quote.

citability.render_parity.title: Much of the visible text only appears after JavaScript runs
citability.render_parity.remediation: Move the text that appears only after hydration into the server response. Compare the two yourself with `curl` and your browser's view-source.

robots.ai_crawler_blocked.title: robots.txt blocks crawlers that AI answers depend on
robots.ai_crawler_blocked.remediation: Allow the listed tokens in robots.txt, or accept that this page cannot appear in those engines' answers. Training tokens and search tokens are separate decisions: you can refuse training and still be citable.

robots.unreachable.title: robots.txt returns a server error
robots.unreachable.remediation: Fix or remove /robots.txt. RFC 9309 tells compliant crawlers to treat a 5xx as a complete disallow, so a broken robots.txt blocks the whole site.

fetch.blocked.title: The page refused an ordinary crawler request
fetch.blocked.remediation: Allowlist the AI crawler tokens in the bot-protection rules. Whatever blocked this request blocks them the same way.

fetch.server_error.title: The page returned a server error
fetch.server_error.remediation: Fix the error and re-run the audit. Nothing on this page was scored, and a crawler that met the same error will have stored nothing either.

fetch.not_found.title: A link points at a page that does not exist
fetch.not_found.remediation: Fix the link or remove it. A crawler that follows it spends part of its budget on a 404, and an engine that followed it from a citation sends the reader nowhere.
